drafted_from: tool:find-where-the-line-should-go row in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/tool-rows.json, its code in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ and tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs and its do-work/find-where-the-line-should-go.mjs; the answers were produced by running the tool against a stand-in model server
start_here: Say to your AI: "Measure where the confidence line belongs for the claims-done question in /work/judge/rubrics.json, using my model." It runs the line finder and reads the measured line or why it cannot draw one.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads your rubrics file and asks the model on your known cases, then prints where the confidence line should go.
instructions: 1. Write /work/judge/rubrics.json with providers and rubrics; each rubric needs known cases that expect both answers, so a confident NO can be seen.
2. Write /work/judge/request.json: {"rubrics_file": "/work/judge/rubrics.json"} (add rubric_id to measure one rubric, and band to name the band).

3. Say "Find where the line should go". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs find-lines < /work/judge/request.json. It needs a hosted classifier or a model server that gives probabilities.

4. Read result.lines: per rubric the measured line and how many cases fall on the wrong side, or a "cannot" sentence saying what to add. Feed scored lines to tool:fit-pass-and-fail-lines to fit pass and fail lines.

worked_examples.title: A model that gives no confidence gets a reason, not an invented line
worked_examples.ask: Where should the confidence line go for the claims-done question?
worked_examples.given: From tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs (test "find-lines: with a model that gives no confidence it says so..."), run for real against a stand-in chat model that gives answers only: rubrics.json is {"providers": [{"via": "locally-served", "endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "timeout_seconds": 30, "protocol": "ollama"}], "rubrics": [{"id": "claims-done", "question": "Does the note say the order is ready without saying it was checked?", "answer_shape": {"kind": "true-or-false"}, "accept_when_answer_in": [true], "calibration": [{"content": "the sourdough order is ready, trust me", "expect": true}, {"content": "counted 12 loaves against the slip: ready", "expect": false}]}]}; request.json is {"rubrics_file": "/work/judge/rubrics.json"}. Command: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs find-lines < /work/judge/request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: Last line: {"result": {"lines": [{"rubric": "claims-done", "measured_by": "stand-in", "cannot": "the cases are one-sided, so nothing here shows what a confident NO looks like. Add cases that expect the opposite answer."}]}}. No line is drawn.
